641: open TensorProduct

643: /-!
644: ### The base-change of a linear map of `R`-modules to a linear map of `A`-modules
645: -/

648: section Semiring

650: variable {R A B M N P : Type*} [CommSemiring R]

656: variable (A) in
657: /-- `baseChange A f` for `f : M →ₗ[R] N` is the `A`-linear map `A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N`.
658: 
659: This "base change" operation is also known as "extension of scalars". -/
660: def baseChange (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N :=
661:   AlgebraTensorModule.map (LinearMap.id : A →ₗ[A] A) f
662: 
663: @[simp]
664: theorem baseChange_tmul (a : A) (x : M) : f.baseChange A (a ⊗ₜ x) = a ⊗ₜ f x :=
665:   rfl
666: 
667: theorem baseChange_eq_ltensor : (f.baseChange A : A ⊗ M → A ⊗ N) = f.lTensor A :=
668:   rfl
669: 
670: @[simp]
671: theorem baseChange_add : (f + g).baseChange A = f.baseChange A + g.baseChange A := by
672:   ext
673:   simp [baseChange_eq_ltensor, -baseChange_tmul]
674:

676: theorem baseChange_zero : baseChange A (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) = 0 := by

681: theorem baseChange_smul : (r • f).baseChange A = r • f.baseChange A := by

686: lemma baseChange_id : (.id : M →ₗ[R] M).baseChange A = .id := by

688:

691:   ext; simp

699:       (f.baseChange B) ∘ₗ (cancelBaseChange R A B B M) := by
700:   ext; simp

702: variable (R M) in
703: @[simp]
704: lemma baseChange_one : (1 : Module.End R M).baseChange A = 1 := baseChange_id
705: 
706: lemma baseChange_mul (f g : Module.End R M) :
707:     (f * g).baseChange A = f.baseChange A * g.baseChange A := by
708:   ext; simp
709: 
710: variable (R A M N)
711: 
712: /-- `baseChange` as a linear map.
713: 
714: When `M = N`, this is true more strongly as `Module.End.baseChangeHom`. -/
715: @[simps]
716: def baseChangeHom : (M →ₗ[R] N) →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N where
717:   toFun := baseChange A

722: @[simps!]
723: def _root_.Module.End.baseChangeHom : Module.End R M →ₐ[R] Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M) :=
724:   .ofLinearMap (LinearMap.baseChangeHom _ _ _ _) (baseChange_one _ _) baseChange_mul

727:     (f ^ n).baseChange A = f.baseChange A ^ n :=

731: def _root_.LinearEquiv.baseChange (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : A ⊗[R] M ≃ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N :=
732:   AlgebraTensorModule.congr (.refl _ _) e

735: theorem _root_.LinearEquiv.coe_baseChange (f : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :

740:     e.baseChange R A M N (a ⊗ₜ m) = a ⊗ₜ e m :=

intro f F hf u

| zero => simp
| tmul s m => simp [Reduction.iota, hf, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ℂ s (m : V)]

23: theorem Prime.dvd_factorial : ∀ {n p : ℕ} (_ : Prime p), p ∣ n ! ↔ p ≤ n
24:   | 0, _, hp => iff_of_false hp.not_dvd_one (not_le_of_gt hp.pos)

26:     rw [factorial_succ, hp.dvd_mul, Prime.dvd_factorial hp]

28:       ⟨fun h => h.elim (le_of_dvd (succ_pos _)) le_succ_of_le, fun h =>
29:         (_root_.lt_or_eq_of_le h).elim (Or.inr ∘ le_of_lt_succ) fun h => Or.inl <| by rw [h]⟩

31: theorem coprime_factorial_iff {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 1) :
32:     m.Coprime n ! ↔ n < m.minFac := by
33:   rw [← not_le, iff_not_comm, Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd]
34:   constructor
35:   · intro h

37:   · rintro ⟨p, hp, hdvd, hdvd'⟩

47:   cast_eq_zero_iff (R p) : ∀ x : ℕ, (x : R) = 0 ↔ p ∣ x

52:     (a : ℕ) [a.AtLeastTwo] (h : p ∣ a) :

54:   rwa [← CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p] at h

56: variable {R} in
57: lemma congr {q : ℕ} (h : p = q) : CharP R q := h ▸ ‹CharP R p›

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type u_2) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_1) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M → Reduction.scalarFacts p K M → ∀ r ≤ l.toNat, ↑r.factorial ≠ 0
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

arguments.statement: ∀ (f g : Module.End ℤ M) (F : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ), (∀ m : M, (f m : V) = F m) → (∀ m : M, (g m : V) = Reduction.divided F r m) → r ≤ l.toNat → g.baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (f.baseChange K)^r
arguments.proof:
intro f g F r hf hg hr
have hn := yui_aux_0010 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 r hr
have hi := yui_aux_0009 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 f g F r hf hg
have he := congrArg (fun q : Module.End ℤ M => q.baseChange K) hi
rw [LinearMap.baseChange_smul, LinearMap.baseChange_pow] at he
rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, Int.cast_natCast] at he
calc
  g.baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • ((r.factorial : K) • g.baseChange K) := by
    rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]
  _ = _ := congrArg (fun q => (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • q) he

have hn := yui_aux_0010 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 r hr

arguments.statement: ∀ (f g : Module.End ℤ M) (F : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ), (∀ m : M, (f m : V) = F m) → (∀ m : M, (g m : V) = Reduction.divided F r m) → r ≤ l.toNat → g.baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (f.baseChange K)^r
arguments.proof:
intro f g F r hf hg hr
have hn := yui_aux_0010 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 r hr
have hi := yui_aux_0009 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 f g F r hf hg
have he := congrArg (fun q : Module.End ℤ M => q.baseChange K) hi
rw [LinearMap.baseChange_smul, LinearMap.baseChange_pow] at he
rw [yui_aux_0011 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008, Int.cast_natCast] at he
calc

    rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]
  _ = _ := congrArg (fun q => (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • q) he

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type u_2) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_1) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M →
                Reduction.scalarFacts p K M →
                  ∀ (f g : End ℤ ↥M) (F : End ℂ V) (r : ℕ),
                    (∀ (m : ↥M), ↑(f m) = F ↑m) →
                      (∀ (m : ↥M), ↑(g m) = (Reduction.divided F r) ↑m) →
                        r ≤ l.toNat → LinearMap.baseChange K g = (↑r.factorial)⁻¹ • LinearMap.baseChange K f ^ r

classical

arguments.statement: ∀ (bar : Reduction.loc p →+* K), letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra; ∀ (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M)), (∀ f : Module.End ℤ M, Phi.toLinearMap.comp (f.baseChange K) = ((f.baseChange (Reduction.loc p)).baseChange K).comp Phi.toLinearMap) → ∀ (A : Reduction.IntegralOps (act x) (act y) (act h) M) (a : Basis (Reduction.Ind l) (Reduction.loc p) (Reduction.MR p M)) (b : ℂ), (∀ i, Reduction.iota p M (a i) = b • Reduction.e (act y) v0 i.val) → ∀ i j : Reduction.Ind l, (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧ Reduction.matrixUnit ((a.baseChange K).map Phi.symm) i j = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K)⁻¹ • ((A.iX (l.toNat-i.val)).baseChange K * (A.iY l.toNat).baseChange K * (A.iX l.toNat).baseChange K * (A.iY (l.toNat-j.val)).baseChange K)

letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
intro Phi hPhi A a b ha i j
classical
let beta := (a.baseChange K).map Phi.symm
obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h_T002.2.2.2.2.1
have hm := h_T004.2 c hc i j
have hnK : (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 := by
  have hu : IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K) := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hm.1.map bar
  exact hu.ne_zero
have hnC : (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  have hu : IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hm.1.map (algebraMap (Reduction.loc p) ℂ)

let f : Module.End ℤ M := A.iX (l.toNat-i.val) * A.iY l.toNat * A.iX l.toNat * A.iY (l.toNat-j.val)
let F : Module.End ℂ V := Reduction.divided (act x) (l.toNat-i.val) * Reduction.divided (act y) l.toNat * Reduction.divided (act x) l.toNat * Reduction.divided (act y) (l.toNat-j.val)
have hf : ∀ m : M, (f m : V) = F m := by
  intro m
  simp only [f, F, Module.End.mul_apply, A.iX_spec, A.iY_spec]
have hF : F = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • Reduction.matrixUnit c i j := by
  calc
    F = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹ • F) := by

    _ = _ := congrArg (fun q => (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • q) hm.2.2.2.1.symm

  have ht := yui_aux_0005 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 bar Phi a b ha f F hf (hPhi f)
  have he : F (Reduction.e (act y) v0 k.val) =

    simp only [hc]

    simpa [hk, beta] using hz
apply beta.ext
intro k
simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply]
have hb : ((A.iX (l.toNat-i.val)).baseChange K * (A.iY l.toNat).baseChange K * (A.iX l.toNat).baseChange K * (A.iY (l.toNat-j.val)).baseChange K) = f.baseChange K := by
